feeds.title: Arte & Sintonia Blog
feeds.description: Arte & Sintonia look for decorative arts in countries in America, Africa, and Asia and the path always connects us to new products, cultures, and stories that they share on this blog. They are a Store of national and imported decorative arts from different countries like India, Indonesia, Morocco, Thailand, and more.

feeds.title: Black Brazil Art Blog
feeds.description: Here we gather theoretical texts but also several articles that are in Brazil and in the world, in order to insert the reader or the curious, in the discussions of race and gender in the arts, as well as the non-limiting thought of curatorial practices.

feeds.title: ArtSoul Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to the publication of news about contemporary art, as well as information about the market, artists and artistic movements in general. ArtSoul is a digital platform that wants to connect you to contemporary art.

feeds.title: Inspiring City » Brazil Street Art
feeds.description: Inspiring City is a street art-focused blog featuring some of the best murals, graffiti art and street artists from London across the UK.A UK based art blog with the best street art and artist interviews with a separate section dedicated to Brazil Street art, their artist, their art events and more.

feeds.title: DailyArt Magazine » Brazil
feeds.description: The official DailyArt app magazine. Enjoy your daily dose of art and visit www.dailyartmagazine.com. Read art history stories about Brazil: all you want and need to know from the archival articles published in DailyArt Magazine.

feeds.title: Newcity Brazil
feeds.description: Newcity Brazil is an English-language digital publishing operation focused on the visual art culture of Brazil, with special emphasis on São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.Newcity Brazil is founded and operated by Newcity in Chicago, a print and web-based culture publication founded in 1986. Newcity publishes the highest volume of art reporting in Chicago, unrivaled even by the mainstream daily newspapers.

feeds.title: Museu de Arte Moderna
feeds.description: The Museum of Modern Art in Rio de Janeiro is a reference institution for art and culture in the country. Founded in 1948, it has one of the most relevant collections of modern and contemporary art in Latin America, with more than 16 thousand works. Its activities take place on the art-education-culture tripod.MAM Rio is a cultural institution constituted as a non-profit civil society of public interest, supported by individuals and companies.

feeds.title: Pivô Blog
feeds.description: Pivô is a non-profit art space providing a platform for exchange, critical thinking, and artistic experimentation inside one of São Paulo's most iconic modernist buildings, the Copan, projected by Oscar Niemeyer in the city's central area.

feeds.title: LAART Blog » Arte
feeds.description: LAART is an online art gallery specializing in multiple, offering a large collection of limited edition prints. The editions are works of art made in series, original, numbered, and signed by the artists. The gallery sells and promotes some of the biggest names in Brazilian and Latin American art, promoting the art market and building a new audience of collectors. Go through their art section and read about Brazilian art culture, world wide arts, events information feature stories, artist profiles and more.

feeds.title: The Rio Times » Art + Culture - Brazil
feeds.description: Hailing from Swiss roots, the Rio Times serves as an independent English-language publication, fostering connection and intrigue for those engrossed in the enigmatic landscapes of Brazil and Latin America.Their mission was and remains to present succinct and articulate insights into the burgeoning news and contemporary issues shaping Brazil and Latin America in English. Their art section features posts on the Brazialn art, their culture, artists' stories, cultural events, feature stories, industry insights and more.

feeds.title: Blombo Blog
feeds.description: Follow Blombô's blog weekly and stay on top of events, exhibitions, news from the art world and especially how to sell your collection. Blombô is an online platform for buying and selling works of art.
